title: Resample the Answer: Where to Spend Test-Time Compute in Recursive Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.16427v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recursive reasoning models such as the Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) iteratively refine two latent states: an answer state y, decoded into the output, and a reasoning state z, which is never decoded. Many of their failures have been attributed to bad basins, regions of latent space that trap the recursion on wrong answers. Recent test-time approaches perturb y, z or both to recover these failures, but the impact of this choice on performance, test-time compute efficiency and scaling properties remains unclear. Through controlled experiments on TRM, we find that a failed trajectory carries its failure in its answer state. At equal compute, whether retries continue a failed trajectory (depth scaling) or draw multiple trajectories from the initial states (width scaling), resampling y recovers more failures than any perturbation of z we tested, and the performance gap widens as the test-time compute budget grows. translated_title: 重采样答案：递归推理中测试时计算应投向何处
translated_abstract: 诸如 Tiny Recursive Model（TRM）等递归推理模型会迭代地精炼两个潜在状态：一个是答案状态 y，会被解码为最终输出；另一个是推理状态 z，从不被解码。这些模型的许多失败被归因于“坏盆地”（bad basins），即潜在空间中使递归陷入错误答案的区域。近期的测试时方法通过扰动 y、z 或两者来挽回这些失败，但这种选择对性能、测试时计算效率以及扩展特性的影响尚不清楚。通过对 TRM 的受控实验，我们发现一条失败的轨迹会将失败携带在其答案状态中。在相同计算量下，无论是重试继续失败的轨迹（深度扩展），还是从初始状态抽取多条轨迹（宽度扩展），重采样 y 都比我们测试过的任何对 z 的扰动能挽回更多失败，并且随着测试时计算预算的增长，性能差距会进一步扩大。我们的方法 Gated Answer...
tldr: 该研究发现递归推理模型的失败主要携带在答案状态 y 中，因此测试时应将计算预算用于重采样 y 而非扰动推理状态 z，这样能挽回更多失败且计算预算越大优势越明显。
en_tdlr: The paper finds that failures of recursive reasoning models are carried in the answer state y, so spending test-time compute on resampling y rather than perturbing the reasoning state z recovers more failures, with the advantage widening as the compute budget grows.
